body.en: The 1927 law established the delimited vineyard area; AOC recognition followed in 1936.
body.zh: 1927 年法律界定葡萄园范围，1936 年获 AOC。

body.en: Montagne de Reims, Vallée de la Marne, Côte des Blancs and Côte des Bar provide the main geographical reference points.
body.zh: Montagne de Reims、Vallée de la Marne、Côte des Blancs、Côte des Bar 是主要地理参照。

body.en: Oceanic and continental influences combine; spring frost, rainfall and slow ripening affect viticulture.
body.zh: 海洋性与大陆性结合；春霜、降雨、缓慢成熟影响栽培。

body.en: Chalk is important alongside limestone, marl, clay and sand; Côte des Bar is not geologically identical to Côte des Blancs.
body.zh: 除白垩外，还有石灰岩、泥灰岩、黏土、砂；Côte des Bar 地质不等于 Côte des Blancs。

body.en: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Meunier dominate; minority grapes require separate identification.
body.zh: Chardonnay、Pinot Noir、Meunier 为主，少量品种须另作识别。

body.en: Arbane, Petit Meslier, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris retain authorised minority roles.
body.zh: Arbane、Petit Meslier、Pinot Blanc、Pinot Gris 保留获准的少量角色。

body.en: Recognised as a principal authorised variety in July 2025; this legal category does not imply large plantings.
body.zh: 2025 年 7 月获认可为法定主要品种；法律类别不表示种植面积很大。

body.en: The Comité Champagne’s September 2026 account describes a VIFA convention, at most 5% of the holding’s planted area (excluding untreated zones) and at most 10% in a blend; monitoring and sample provision are required.
body.zh: Comité Champagne 2026 年 9 月资料说明：VIFA 协议下，最多占酒庄种植面积 5%（不含不处理区域），最多占调配 10%；要求技术跟踪及样品提供。

body.en: A 4,000 kg marc corresponds to 2,550 L of permitted must: 2,050 L cuvée and 500 L taille.
body.zh: 每 4,000 kg 一批葡萄对应 2,550 L 许可汁液：2,050 L cuvée、500 L taille。

body.en: These are successive press fractions, not finished-wine quality ranks. Keeping them separate creates blending options.
body.zh: 这是连续压榨分段，不是成酒质量分级；分开保存提供调配选择。

body.en: Base-wine lots are assembled before tirage; grape, site and reserve-wine choices influence the final style.
body.zh: 基酒在 tirage 前调配；品种、地块、储备酒选择影响成酒风格。

body.en: Bottling with the fermentation preparation starts the bottle-fermentation stage and maturation clock.
body.zh: 装瓶加入发酵准备物，启动瓶中发酵阶段及陈年计时。

body.en: At least 15 months before release, including at least 12 months on lees.
body.zh: 上市前至少 15 个月，其中至少 12 个月接触酒泥。

body.en: Vintage Champagne requires at least three years; many producers mature wines longer.
body.zh: 年份 Champagne 至少三年；许多生产者延长陈年。

body.en: Yeast autolysis contributes texture and mature aromas during lees ageing.
body.zh: 酵母自溶在酒泥陈年中贡献质感与成熟香气。

body.en: Slow oxygen exchange also participates in maturation; lees time alone does not reveal dosage.
body.zh: 缓慢氧交换也参与成熟；酒泥时间本身不能说明补糖量。

body.en: A separate still-wine appellation, not an unsparkling version within Champagne AOC.
body.zh: 独立静止酒产区，不是 Champagne AOC 内的无气泡版本。

body.en: A distinct still-rosé appellation whose geographical and production identity must be retained.
body.zh: 独立静止桃红产区，须保留其地理与生产身份。

body.en: The estate's technical account provides a concrete reference for cuvée and taille press fractions.
body.zh: 酒庄技术资料为 cuvée 与 taille 提供具体生产实例。

body.en: Its ageing account separates legal minima from the longer maturation selected by a house.
body.zh: 其陈年资料区分法定最低要求与酒庄自选的更长陈年。

body.en: Compare dosage, reserve wines and lees age independently.
body.zh: 分别比较补糖、储备酒与酒泥陈年。

body.en: The Paris Universal Exhibition under Napoleon III prompted the famous 1855 classification.
body.zh: Napoléon III 时期巴黎世博会促成著名 1855 分级。

body.en: Garonne and Dordogne join in the Gironde estuary; left- and right-bank identities depend on this geography.
body.zh: Garonne、Dordogne 汇成 Gironde 河口；左右岸身份取决于此地理。

body.en: Saint-Estèphe, Pauillac, Saint-Julien and Margaux lie along the Médoc bank; Moulis and Listrac lie farther inland.
body.zh: Saint-Estèphe、Pauillac、Saint-Julien、Margaux 位于 Médoc 河侧；Moulis、Listrac 更内陆。

body.en: Oceanic moderation and rainfall make ripening and disease management vintage-dependent.
body.zh: 海洋调节与降雨使成熟、病害管理依年份而变。

body.en: Médoc gravel terraces are important, but not universal across the left bank.
body.zh: Médoc 砾石河阶重要，但并非整个左岸通用。

body.en: Saint-Estèphe, Moulis and Listrac include clay-limestone terrain, complicating simple bank stereotypes.
body.zh: Saint-Estèphe、Moulis、Listrac 含黏土石灰质，不能只靠左右岸刻板概括。

body.en: Cabernet Sauvignon is central in Médoc; Merlot and Cabernet Franc are especially important in right-bank blends.
body.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon 对 Médoc 重要；Merlot、Cabernet Franc 对右岸调配尤其重要。

body.en: Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon and Muscadelle underpin major white-wine styles.
body.zh: Sauvignon Blanc、Sémillon、Muscadelle 构成主要白酒风格基础。

body.en: Dry white and noble-rot sweet-wine production pursue different harvest and fermentation outcomes.
body.zh: 干白与贵腐甜酒追求不同采收及发酵结果。

body.en: Médoc estates plus Château Haut-Brion in Graves form the red classification.
body.zh: Médoc 酒庄加 Graves 的 Château Haut-Brion 构成红酒名单。

body.en: The red classification has five ranks, from first to fifth growth; estates are ranked, not Burgundy-style Climats.
body.zh: 红酒由一级至五级，分级对象为酒庄，而非 Bourgogne 式 Climats。

body.en: Sauternes and Barsac have a separate 1855 sweet-white classification.
body.zh: Sauternes、Barsac 有独立 1855 甜白分级。

body.en: Graves has its own classification separate from the 1855 system.
body.zh: Graves 有独立于 1855 的自身分级。

body.en: Its estate classification is periodically revised; Saint-Émilion Grand Cru AOC alone does not mean Grand Cru Classé.
body.zh: 酒庄分级定期修订；Saint-Émilion Grand Cru AOC 本身不等于 Grand Cru Classé。

body.en: A separate Médoc classification for red wines; it is not a subset of the 1855 list.
body.zh: Médoc 红酒另一分级，不是 1855 名单子集。

body.en: A distinct Médoc classification associated with smaller craft-oriented estates; not a grape or a synonym for Cru Bourgeois.
body.zh: 与较小手工经营酒庄相关的 Médoc 独立分级；不是品种，也不是 Cru Bourgeois 同义词。

body.en: Appellation describes protected origin; classification describes a separate historical estate-ranking context.
body.zh: 法定产区描述受保护产地；分级是另一历史酒庄等级体系。

body.en: Located in Pauillac and a first growth in the 1855 classification.
body.zh: 位于 Pauillac，为 1855 一级庄。

body.en: The Graves exception in the red 1855 classification illustrates why geography and ranking must both be retained.
body.zh: 1855 红酒分级的 Graves 例外，说明须同时保留地理与等级。

body.en: Use the actual bottle, vintage and maturation when planning decanting.
body.zh: 按具体酒款、年份及成熟状态安排醒酒。

body.en: Oceanic influence dominates westward; continental influence increases inland to the east.
body.zh: 西部海洋性明显，向东内陆大陆性加强。

body.en: Nantais crystalline rocks and Anjou schist differ from the chalky tuffeau of Saumur and Touraine.
body.zh: Nantais 结晶岩、Anjou 片岩，与 Saumur、Touraine 白垩质 tuffeau 不同。

body.en: Marly terres blanches, stony limestone caillottes and flint-rich clays are distinct geological families.
body.zh: 泥灰岩 terres blanches、多石石灰质 caillottes、富燧石黏土为不同类群。

body.en: Alluvial sand and gravel terraces contrast with the marl and flint of other Centre-Loire sites.
body.zh: 冲积砂砾河阶与其他 Centre-Loire 地块泥灰岩、燧石不同。

body.en: Le Haut-Lieu: deeper clay; Le Mont: flint-bearing soils; Clos du Bourg: limestone.
body.zh: Le Haut-Lieu：较深黏土；Le Mont：含燧石；Clos du Bourg：石灰岩。

body.en: Melon de Bourgogne, Chenin Blanc, Cabernet Franc and Sauvignon Blanc anchor different regional identities.

body.en: Saumur-Champigny, Chinon, Bourgueil and Saint-Nicolas-de-Bourgueil are distinct red-wine references.

body.en: Separate Chenin appellations on opposite Loire banks near Tours; both include still and sparkling expressions.

body.zh: Sauvignon Blanc 核心；Sancerre 亦有 Pinot Noir 红、桃红。

body.en: Crémant de Loire, Saumur and Vouvray have separate rules despite shared bottle-fermentation principles.
body.zh: Crémant de Loire、Saumur、Vouvray 虽同有瓶中发酵，规则各异。

body.en: Dry, sweet, still and sparkling wines coexist; no single Loire recipe covers them all.

body.en: Right bank in Ardèche, between Saint-Joseph to the north and Saint-Péray to the south.

body.en: Jura combines local grapes, topped-up whites and sous-voile styles; wider Franche-Comté heritage extends beyond these AOCs.

body.en: AOC recognition in 1936 places Arbois among the earliest French wine appellations.

body.en: Vineyards cluster around Arbois, Poligny and Lons-le-Saunier on the western Jura foothills.
body.zh: 葡萄园聚集于 Jura 西侧山麓 Arbois、Poligny、Lons-le-Saunier 周边。

body.en: Cold winters, warm summers and significant rainfall shape the vineyard cycle.
body.zh: 寒冬、温暖夏季及较多降雨塑造生长周期。

body.en: Blue and grey marls and limestone provide key geological references.
body.zh: 蓝、灰泥灰岩及石灰岩为主要地质参照。

body.en: Chardonnay and Savagnin are the principal white references.
body.zh: Chardonnay、Savagnin 为主要白品种参照。

body.en: Poulsard, Trousseau and Pinot Noir form the core red-grape set.
body.zh: Poulsard、Trousseau、Pinot Noir 构成红品种核心。

body.en: Topping up limits headspace and oxygen exposure; Savagnin can be made ouillé without becoming vin jaune.
body.zh: 添桶减少顶部空间与氧接触；Savagnin 可以添桶酿造，并不成为 vin jaune。

body.en: A surface yeast veil produces biological ageing distinct from simple air oxidation.
body.zh: 表面酵母膜形成生物陈年，与简单空气氧化不同。

body.en: Vin jaune is made from Savagnin.
body.zh: Vin jaune 用 Savagnin。

body.en: The reference duration is six years and three months from harvest, including long ageing without topping up under voile.
body.zh: 参照期限为采收后六年三个月，其中长时间不添桶、酒膜下陈年。

body.en: The traditional bottle holds 62 cl; this does not establish a fixed evaporation percentage.
body.zh: 传统酒瓶容量 62 cl；不能据此断言固定蒸发比例。

body.en: Harvested grapes are dried to concentrate must; this is not the same process as fortification or voile ageing.
body.zh: 采收后葡萄干燥浓缩汁液；与强化、酒膜陈年不同。

body.en: A mistelle combining grape must and grape spirit; not a Savagnin synonym.
body.zh: 葡萄汁与葡萄烈酒组成的 mistelle；不是 Savagnin 同义名。

body.en: Distilled grape-pomace spirit, distinct from Macvin and vin jaune.

body.en: Historic local vineyard names predate the modern Savoie and Roussette de Savoie framework.

body.en: Altitude, slope aspect and lake moderation matter alongside the general Alpine influence.
body.zh: 海拔、坡向、湖泊调节与整体阿尔卑斯影响同样重要。

body.en: Limestone scree, moraine, clay-marl, alluvium and local schist-bearing materials create varied sites.

body.en: Central to light-bodied local whites, especially Apremont, Abymes and Chignin references.

body.en: Chasselas on Léman shores and Gringet around Ayze broaden the regional identity.
body.zh: Léman 湖岸 Chasselas、Ayze 周边 Gringet 扩展地区身份。

body.en: An Altesse white appellation separate from Savoie AOC.
body.zh: Altesse 白酒产区，独立于 Savoie AOC。

body.en: Frangy, Marestel, Monterminod and Monthoux can supplement Roussette de Savoie under their own conditions.

body.en: A Roussanne identity; not an Altesse wine.
body.zh: Roussanne 身份，不是 Altesse 酒。

body.en: A geographical wine name for Mondeuse, not a different grape.
body.zh: Mondeuse 的地理酒名，不是另一品种。

body.en: Separate from Savoie and Bugey; still whites and sparkling wines have distinct grape conditions.
body.zh: 独立于 Savoie、Bugey；静止白及起泡有不同品种条件。

body.en: Altesse is the still-wine reference unless the Molette variety is explicitly indicated.
body.zh: 静止酒以 Altesse 为参照，明确标示 Molette 时例外。

body.en: Molette and Altesse may be joined by Chasselas in sparkling blends.
body.zh: 起泡调配中 Molette、Altesse 可加入 Chasselas。

body.en: The family estate sits at Chignin-Torméry on the Torméry hillside.
body.zh: 家族庄位于 Chignin-Torméry 的 Torméry 坡地。
